title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 3, QA) - Quant - Logarithms Exponents
subject: Quant

questions.q: If $3^a=4, 4^b=5, 5^c=6, 6^d=7, 7^e=8$ and $8^f=9$, then the value of the product abcdef is:
questions.explain: This can be written using logs: $a=\log_3 4$, $b=\log_4 5$, etc. The product abcdef = $\log_3 4 \cdot \log_4 5 \cdots \log_8 9$. By the change of base rule, this simplifies to $\log_3 9 = 2$.
questions.subject: Quant

questions.q: The sum of all distinct real values of ${x}$ that satisfy the equation $10^x+\frac{4}{10^x}=\frac{17}{2}$, is:
questions.explain: Let $y=10^x$. The equation becomes $y + 4/y = 17/2$. This gives $2y^2 - 17y + 8 = 0$. The solutions are $y=8$ and $y=1/2$. So $10^x=8$ and $10^x=1/2$. The values of x are $\log_{10} 8$ and $\log_{10} (1/2)$. Sum = $\log_{10} 8 + \log_{10} (0.5) = \log_{10} (8*0.5) = \log_{10} 4 = 2\log_{10} 2$.
